//! The `polite` concept's failures.

/// Why a `polite` operation failed.
#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum PoliteError {
    /// The name is empty.
    #[error("the name is empty")]
    Empty,
}

impl PoliteError {
    /// Whether the name can be fixed by the caller.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn fixable(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self, Self::Empty)
    }
}
